cohort: The study included ninety-one twin pairs (forty-two with CD and forty-nine with UC) recruited from the UK IBD Twin Registry.
finding: The study supports the heritability of IBD, with MZ twin pairs showing greater concordance, and identified several environmental factors associated with IBD, such as cigarette smoking being predictive of CD and breastfeeding being protective against UC.
mod_finding: Method of delivery did not impact future IBD concordance.
